params.name: relation
params.description: ConceptNet relation name (e.g. IsA, UsedFor, RelatedTo)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (0-100000)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (0-1000)

items.docs: Returns a paginated JSON-LD list of all edges using the specified relation type. Valid relation names include IsA, UsedFor, CapableOf, AtLocation, Causes, HasProperty, PartOf, SimilarTo, Antonym, RelatedTo, DerivedFrom, Synonym, and many others defined in the ConceptNet relation vocabulary.
